decision: NO-GO for a new quantitative stage under this scoped all-model venetoclax proposal
scientific_scope: Empirical native-model drug response, not target dependency or clinical benefit
reason: Exact primary monotherapy nonvalidation and model-specific carfilzomib combination pattern are already reported. Available NCC venetoclax screening label/selected-panel omission, with unresolved exposure/control compatibility and dose-response availability, does not yet define an important source-compatible unanswered comparison.
pair_resolution: Actual Results/Figure6 pairs are carfilzomib+venetoclax and carfilzomib+doxorubicin. Discussion names venetoclax+doxorubicin inconsistently; no third-pair dataset inferred.
coverage: All three known native donor/model contexts retained, plus broader genuine/public identity and condition gaps. Only source/qualitative claims evaluated anew; pending suitable curves/matrices/conditions remain pending, not negative/unavailable.
reopening: A genuinely authenticated native model/condition venetoclax response-control dataset with exact dose, duration, medium and readout supports a consequential comparison beyond the published qualitative result.
The prospective claim and disproof must precede any new response quantities; root separately authorizes a finite exact assay-separated or exposure-compatible analysis.

Public raw/processed combination or single-agent curves may resolve an actual reproducibility question if new use is justified; no posthoc synergy estimator/cutoff selection or clinical-exposure assumption.
publication: No surviving publication-worthy finding from this gate; no manuscript
